title: Inconsistent Reads across Unsynchronized Fields
pattern: Reading multiple related fields of an object sequentially in separate unsynchronized operations, allowing writers to modify fields concurrently.
why_bad: The reader thread will load inconsistent state (e.g., an updated balance with an old ledger_id), violating the structural transactional integrity invariants of the object.
detection: Exposing multiple getters or reading multiple state fields of a mutable class without acquiring a shared lock or transaction block over the entire read block.
counterexample: Wrapping the entire read sequence in a single synchronized block or transaction.
fix: Acquire a single shared lock or wrap the entire read block in a transaction: `synchronized(this) { ... }` to guarantee a consistent read.
source: [The Addison-Wesley signature series] Martin Fowler - PEAA, p. 235 [235].
